roleHelp.Admin: Manages the space, its members and every project.
roleHelp.Developer: Builds projects and works on tasks.
roleHelp.Member: Follows projects and comments, e.g. finance or HR.
roleHelp.Guest: Outside collaborator who can view and comment.

create.title: Create your space
create.subtitle: A space holds your organization's members and projects. Only people you invite can see it.
create.keyHelp: A short code for this space, like ZEROONE. API calls and integrations (such as MCP) use it to find your space, so it can't be changed later.
create.previewDescription: Your space description will appear here.
create.keyExplainer: The key identifies this space everywhere outside the app, so it stays the same even if you rename the space.

keyStatus.invalid: Use 2-10 letters or numbers, starting with a letter.
keyStatus.unknown: Couldn't check availability. You can still continue.

create.waitingInvite: Expecting an invitation? Ask your admin to invite {{email}}, then

details.title: Details
details.keyHelp: Used by API calls and integrations. It can't be changed.

settings.title: Space settings
settings.subtitle: Manage who is in {{name}} and what they can do.
settings.name: Space name

invite.title: Invite people
invite.help: New people get an email to set their password. People who already have an account are added right away.
invite.emailFailed: Invitation saved, but the email could not be sent ({{reason}}). They can sign up with {{email}} to join.

members.title: Members
members.removeBody: They will lose access to this space and its projects. Their account is not deleted.
